description:
Downloads an attachment of a received message, saves it to disk and returns its content: text for text files, the text of every page for PDFs, the picture for images.
Scans (PDF pages without a text layer) and photos of documents are read through OCR, tables included; pages that came from OCR are marked “(OCR)” — treat numbers from them with some caution and ask for a preview when a figure matters.
Other types (docx, xlsx, zip…) only return the path of the saved file.
Pick the attachment by name or by its number from the list in mail_get_email; a message with a single attachment needs neither. The message itself is not changed.

account.description: Which account: leave empty for the signed-in mailbox, or name a shared mailbox / group you have access to (the part before @ is enough; a full address works too). mail_list_mailboxes shows what exists.

attachment.description: Attachment name (a part is enough, e.g. “invoice”) or its number starting at 1.

ocr.description: false = do not send scans and photos to the OCR provider, return the image only.

page_to.description: PDF: last page to return (default: the last one).

preview.description: PDF: also attach an image of page 1 (chart, stamp, signature, checking the OCR).

save_dir.description: Folder to save the file to; default /tmp/churn-4ay3fsx6/Downloads/Mail-Attachments.

name: mail_get_attachment
title: Open an attachment
